relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF expression strongly correlated with SP levels (r = 0.785; p = 5.268 × 10−9), suggesting their potential co-involvement in nociceptive signaling and pain generation in DDD.

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed a positive correlation between the expression levels of NGF and SP and the severity of histological disc degeneration (r = 0.467, p = 0.010 and r = 0.611, p = 0.0006, respectively)

key_findings: In young DDD patients NGF and SP are elevated in degenerated discs, strongly correlated, and track degeneration severity; free nerve endings only in patients.
Aggrecan loss correlated with pain duration; ECM calcification associated with radiculopathy.
